critical_code_review_comments: FIXED BUG: Pydantic models (ServicoOS, PecaOS, OrdemServico) had float fields that didn't support Optional, causing 500 errors when sanitization set values to None for funcionários/motoristas. Changed valor, valor_unitario, valor_total, valor_servicos, valor_pecas, valor_desconto to Optional[float].

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Blue/Yellow colors (#1e3a5f/#f59e0b) applied in Layout sidebar and Portal do Cliente. 2) Photo Upload (POST /api/ordens-servico/{id}/fotos) and Delete work for ADM only. 3) WhatsApp link generation creates proper wa.me link with formatted message. 4) Value sanitization correctly hides prices from funcionários/motoristas (both in API response and UI). 5) 'Relatório Visual de Qualidade' section present in both ViewOS and Portal do Cliente with 'Antes (Recebimento)' and 'Depois (Finalizado)' sections. 6) Timeline in Portal shows yellow active steps. Bug fixed: models.py fields now support Optional[float] for sanitization.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: The sanitize_os_for_role() function in server.py was setting price fields to None for funcionarios/motoristas, but the Pydantic models (ServicoOS.valor, PecaOS.valor_unitario/valor_total, OrdemServico.valor_*) were defined as required float fields. This caused Pydantic validation error '500 Internal Server Error' when returning sanitized data. Fix: Changed all affected float fields to Optional[float] = None in models.py.
